raw_baseline.name: C18 stored help_app/evaluation.json after the conservative three-unnamed-operation context fix and before final SDD source integration
raw_baseline.comparison_purpose: Isolate any retrieval change from the final SDD source integration; this is not the C17 base comparison.

routing_finding: Knowledge indexes approved help-topic explanation fields, optional reviewed SQL details and documentary process refinements. Only explicitly bound SDD claims load through reviewed_sdd_source; the 373-claim/292-setting register is not wholesale indexed. Source/extraction hashes do not create new search rows.
review_scope: Reuse all39 prior question/expected/returned-answer relevance dispositions. Read relevant new C18 source claims/limits, current search/index/source routing, and exact related claim/node/hash bindings. No claim of a new full transitive SQL audit or reading every sentence in all373 SDD claims.
source_boundary: Reference-site examples cannot establish TAB configuration, caller transactions, SQL grouping/defaults, delivery, runtime or current permissions. LAND MAWM excluded from SCALE bridge candidates.

cases.frozen_question: Does the routine return five result sets?
cases.practical_clarification: Which operation or routine should return those result sets?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: The routine is unnamed; many routines discuss result sets. The expected topic has a fifth-result exclusion, whereas the question uses five.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: The shipment-upload payload account describes header/detail/container families. It does not identify the unnamed routine or establish five SQL result sets.

cases.frozen_question: Does a profile select one deterministic detail row?
cases.practical_clarification: Which work-execution profile/sequence selector are you asking about, and which option or detail row?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Work selection reads some options by profile alone and others by profile plus sequence; a profile does not guarantee one deterministic detail row.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Work priority/escalation is a source-site ordering choice; it cannot establish whether this SQL profile selector reads one deterministic detail row. Existing duplicate-configuration already supplies a qualified alternative.

cases.frozen_question: Does an error guarantee all earlier changes are rolled back?
cases.practical_clarification: Which operation produced the error, and is the question about its own transaction or a caller transaction?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: No adjustment, routine or operation is named. Rollback and caller-transaction limits apply to many distinct reviewed operations.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Site shortage/adjustment coordination does not establish caller transactions, rollback scope or the unnamed failing operation.

cases.frozen_question: Can two identical warehouse filters prove the same result?
cases.practical_clarification: Which work-monitor views are being compared: group chart, work-type drilldown, totals, or another report?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Equal warehouse filters alone do not equalize work-group scope, predicates or aggregation; work-type chart and totals apply the selected group, with missing/unassigned group selecting no-group work.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: A labor group definition does not establish Work Monitor SQL predicates, group-specific aggregations or whether two identically named warehouse filters produce the same result.

cases.frozen_question: Does no row mean zero work?
cases.practical_clarification: Is this a Work Monitor indicator tile with a known selector, or a work list/report returning no rows?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: A recognized indicator returns one count row including zero; an unknown/NULL selector returns no result set. Missing output does not establish zero work.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: No new SDD claim defines selector dispatch versus COUNT zero/no-result-set behavior. A work/pool status description is not a returned-row contract.

cases.frozen_question: Is this always one atomic operation?
cases.practical_clarification: Which operation should succeed or roll back as one unit?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: This and operation do not identify deactivation, work or inactive storage. Many reviewed operations have conditional atomicity.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Documented load closure/end-state effects do not establish atomic work deactivation or the unnamed operation.

cases.frozen_question: Does reservation prove stock left?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: inventory-tracking-aim nodes n87/n90/n93/n96/n99: on hand remains until picked; allocated has not yet physically been picked. Separate quantity-effect flags corroborate captured SQL. Expected concept is appropriate; stock left can also mean remaining stock, so phrase intent merits clarification.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Knipper separates staging, loading and load-confirmed departure, giving compatible process context. The exact reservation-versus-physical-stock distinction was already supplied by indexed AIM Inventory Tracking and the expected answer. The SDD adds no missing vendor rule or observed movement proof; stock left also needs departure-versus-remaining clarification.

cases.frozen_question: Does archival prove commit?
cases.practical_clarification: Which archival operation and caller transaction do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Archival does not identify empty source inventory or the movement caller. Archive/commit limitations are shared by many reviewed routines.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Inventory-upload eligibility says nothing about source-inventory archive caller commit. An archival operation and transaction context are still missing.

cases.frozen_question: Can the header status only advance?
cases.practical_clarification: Which header and action: shipment ship-confirmation, receipt rollup, load rollup, or a configured workflow transition?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: The ship-confirm routine writes caller-supplied header statuses without proving an advance-only or permitted-transition rule; application transition policy is separate.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Leading/trailing summaries and the source-site Closed rollup do not prove that the captured direct header UPDATE is advance-only. A valid workflow narrative must not replace the routine contract.

cases.frozen_question: Can an arbitrary alphanumeric ID pass through unchanged?
cases.practical_clarification: Which identifier field and creating or converting operation do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: An arbitrary alphanumeric ID does not identify receipt-container generation. The indexed explanation uses numeric conversion rather than the complete question vocabulary.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: The new pallet/group receiving descriptions do not supply receipt-container identifier conversion, accepted alphabet or pass-through rules. The identifier field/operation remains unnamed.

cases.frozen_question: Does NULL mean status zero?
cases.practical_clarification: Is NULL the result of the action-to-status lookup, a next-status function, a status slot, or a displayed field?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Action-to-status lookup can return NULL when a mapping layer has no match. NULL does not mean numeric status 0.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: New pool/rejected status meanings do not specify NULL handling in the action-to-status SQL lookup. Numeric 0 and NULL cannot be equated from a glossary.

cases.frozen_question: Are all steps serialized by this gate?
cases.practical_clarification: Which gate and processing sequence do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: This gate has no supplied name or wave context. Porter stems serialized to serial, allowing unrelated serial-number passages to compete.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Illustrative wave steps and a manual pre-execution reconciliation do not define the unnamed statistics gate, critical section or serialization scope.

cases.frozen_question: Does active mean the worker is alive?
cases.practical_clarification: Which active field or worker monitor are you reading?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Active and worker do not identify the active-wave list or dialog routines. The source describes a last-step predicate rather than worker liveness.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: A site item remaining active and a shipment pool status are different from an active-wave worker-liveness test. Neither identifies the unnamed active field.

cases.frozen_question: Does the helper reserve more stock?
cases.practical_clarification: Which helper is selecting or reserving stock?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: The helper is unnamed; reserving stock fits many allocation/inventory helpers. The expected topic is about conversion selection.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Allocation sequence/selection prose explains eligibility and remaining demand, not whether an unnamed conversion helper reserves stock or writes inventory.

cases.frozen_question: Does no row return 0 and100 automatically?
cases.practical_clarification: Which function or output fields should return those values?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: No capacity, replenishment or function is named. The concatenated and100 is already split into and and 100 by the existing tokenizer.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Storage/UOM assumptions do not define the SQL no-row capacity output pair or default precedence. The function and fields remain unnamed.

cases.frozen_question: What if both branch counts equal three?
cases.practical_clarification: Which routine and two branch counts do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Both branch counts is mathematically meaningful but names no process/function. The source UNION equal-count behavior is present; exact-word matching substantially changes its rank.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: A generic flow containing replenishment does not define two branch-count projections or UNION duplicate elimination. The two branches remain unspecified.

cases.frozen_question: Are these settings confirmed for the current warehouse?
cases.practical_clarification: Which settings or screen do you mean? Current warehouse values are not established by this library.
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: These settings has no setting names or QC subject. Many source-limit passages correctly say current warehouse settings are not established.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: The reviewed SDD claims are reference-site designs and explicitly do not establish TAB settings. They reinforce that source choices are not current configuration; they cannot identify the unnamed settings or supply deployed values.

cases.frozen_question: Does one failed shipment roll back the entire wave automatically?
cases.practical_clarification: Which wave step failed—shipping-container numbering or another wave action—and is there an enclosing caller transaction?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Container wave numbering uses separate per-shipment BEGIN/COMMIT pairs, not one whole-wave transaction; ambient caller transactions can alter persistence.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: The load-confirmed end state and shipment splitting assumption provide no per-shipment/whole-wave transaction ownership or rollback guarantees. The exact step and caller transaction remain necessary.

cases.frozen_question: Does In Process prevent a second claimant?
cases.practical_clarification: Which upload staging/batch claim routine and interface condition are involved?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: The upload claim predicate excludes Processed, not In Process; an already In Process row can be restamped. That status alone is not an exclusive-claim guarantee.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: In Pool Pending prevents shipment waving in the documented interface process; it is a different status and operation from In Process upload-batch claiming. No exclusive claim/locking guarantee can be transferred.

cases.frozen_question: Will the serial helper skip records from a previous run?
cases.practical_clarification: Which serial helper: upload payload creation, operational lookup, or archive copy/delete? Are you asking about repeat-run deduplication?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: The upload serial helper inserts selected payload rows without an explicit previous-run deduplication guard; separate constraints/caller behavior would require evidence.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Shipment payloads can include serial data, and the host may handle multiple files. Neither passage defines previous-run serial helper deduplication, target constraints or idempotency.

cases.frozen_question: Does UNION preserve every physical source row?
cases.practical_clarification: Is the question about UNION generally or a particular interface upload current/retained view?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: UNION removes duplicates of the selected columns, so separate physical rows can collapse; UNION ALL preserves duplicate projected rows. Interface views do not imply delivery, freshness or archive execution.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: No new SDD describes SQL UNION projection deduplication. The already returned view-retained-unions answer supplies a valid scoped alternative; a new site bridge is unnecessary.

cases.frozen_question: Is NULL same as default zero?
cases.practical_clarification: Which field or function has the NULL/default rule?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: NULL/default/zero has no function or status-slot identity. Many defaulting contracts differ, so selecting one silently would invent context.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: New status glossaries do not define NULL/default-zero behavior in an unnamed status-slot function. The existing captured function remains the appropriate evidence.

cases.frozen_question: Are all no-match outputs0?
cases.practical_clarification: Which function or output is missing a match?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: No quantity or function is named. Existing tokens split outputs0 correctly; numeric zero and word zero remain lexically distinct.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Allocation eligibility prose does not define missing-match scalar outputs across availability helper variants. A function or field is still required.

cases.frozen_question: Does text prove every value is present?
cases.practical_clarification: Which report or text-producing function do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Text/every value does not identify bounded report-string helpers, serial/BOL lists or the output limit.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: The label/document certification responsibility note does not define truncation, missing values or completeness in the unnamed report-text helper.

cases.frozen_question: Does missing shipment always returnNULL?
cases.practical_clarification: Do you mean the BOL stop/ordinal helper, shipment detail summary, or another shipment lookup?

cases.source_to_question_assessment: The new packing-list print timing does not define the BOL helper cursor/no-match return value. Missing shipment is shared vocabulary across distinct operations.

cases.frozen_question: Are work date windows always a full local calendar day?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: fn-batch-1612181139, DASHFn_GetKPIValue, source line 297 adds one day to warehouseDay12AMInUtc. Work KPI context is necessary to establish this exact rule; dashboard answer is appropriate within that scope.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Labor-group UOM/staffing context supplies no dashboard UTC-day calculation or DST boundary. The captured KPI branch, already indexed, is required for this exact work-date rule.

cases.frozen_question: Does percentage0 always mean no work processed?
cases.practical_clarification: Which dashboard/KPI ID and percentage formula are shown, and what time/warehouse scope applies?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: A percentage zero can be a no-data/zero-denominator fallback in the selected dashboard formula; it is not proof that no physical work was processed.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: A source labor plan or count reconciliation does not define the dashboard percentage denominator, NULL comparisons or fallback zero. The KPI/field/time scope must be identified.

cases.frozen_question: Do retained table references mean archive jobs ran during this review?
cases.practical_clarification: Are you asking what the retained-source view can read, or whether this documentation review executed archive jobs?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: References in source definitions establish read/mutation possibilities, not execution during this review. The review accessed definitions only and ran no archive jobs.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Historical conversion/archive-year planning is not execution evidence. Already returned archive-related topics explicitly say no archive work ran; no SDD citation is needed to establish this session boundary.

cases.frozen_question: Must minimum component item and minimum line ID come from one component?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.

cases.source_to_question_assessment: No new SDD specifies the independent MIN expressions or joined grouping of the captured work-order header view. The source-supported distinction exists in the current SQL explanation, but its expected topic remains absent from the first eight.

cases.frozen_question: Do two serial rows necessarily mean two separate inventory balances?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.

cases.source_to_question_assessment: Grupo serial nonuse is a site exclusion, and Knipper excludes full DSCSA detail. Neither defines SQL serial-join fanout. The already returned catch-weight/history optional detail covers the shared inventory view with a depth limit.

cases.frozen_question: Is total ordered quantity net of allocation?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: vr-sql-2098314735 ITEM_ORDER_QUANTITY_VIEW lines 9-18 SUM(SD.TOTAL_QTY), threshold and grouping; no subtraction of allocation in this view. Expected answer is appropriate only for that field/view, not every report called ordered quantity.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: The shipment message quantity UOM and allocation remainder descriptions are not the ITEM_ORDER_QUANTITY_VIEW formula. They cannot establish whether TOTAL_QTY is net of allocation.

cases.frozen_question: What can a missing selected separator cause?
cases.practical_clarification: Which file/path function and separator selection do you mean?

cases.source_to_question_assessment: No new SDD establishes separator selection, path parsing or substring error behavior in the captured document-file-name helper.

cases.frozen_question: Does a successful first stage guarantee the full batch?
cases.practical_clarification: Which batch workflow and first stage do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: First stage/full batch names no download operation. Many independent batch/transaction workflows have similar success limitations.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Shipment error correction/reprocessing describes a later retry path, not one atomic full-batch guarantee after an unnamed first stage. It cannot replace staged SQL claims/transactions.

cases.frozen_question: Does receipt selection prove upload delivered?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: dynamic-dependency-314796529/330796586/346796643 and corresponding current reviewed dynamic contracts bind batch mutation/selection. Expected filter topic is over-specific for the original broad receipt-delivery question. Returned receipt-candidate answer already states the required distinction. Keep frozen expectation and add separate relevance judgment.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Source-site eligibility, file generation and proposed timing explicitly stop short of host delivery/acceptance. This supports the same caution, but receipt selection versus completed delivery is already adequately explained by returned receipt-candidate and upload-batch topics. The frozen expected filter ID remains an over-specific target for this wording.

cases.frozen_question: Is its source the captured local shipment table?
cases.practical_clarification: Which report or routine source do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Its source supplies no report name; local shipment table is insufficient to identify the external fixed report.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: No new SDD identifies the unnamed fixed report source or proves it reads a captured local shipment table rather than an external object.

cases.frozen_question: Should every returned item be automatically corrected or written off?
cases.practical_clarification: Which diagnostic report returned the items? A result is not by itself authority to correct or write off inventory.
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Every returned item does not identify the inventory diagnostic or finding. Corrected/written off are not a unique process identity.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Damage/shortage review is conditional site practice, not authority to correct every row from an unnamed diagnostic. The specific diagnostic and remediation evidence remain necessary.

cases.frozen_question: Does a NULL stored override always remain NULL?
cases.practical_clarification: Which stored override field or configuration lookup do you mean?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: Stored override is shared terminology without accessorial/shipment/carrier identity. Many NULL/default contracts compete.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: No new SDD establishes NULL override fallback in the specific captured accessorial selector. The override field/routine is still unnamed.

cases.frozen_question: Does shipment-detail fallback use internal shipment number?
cases.practical_clarification: Identify the named process, view/field and intended meaning before generalizing the result.

cases.source_to_question_assessment: Shipment header/detail payload families do not identify the fallback lookup predicate or distinguish internal SHIPMENT_NUM from external SHIPMENT_ID. The captured wm_I/UShipmentDetail source remains required.

cases.frozen_question: Can a missing container still produce display rows?
cases.practical_clarification: Which close-container display/model routine and which result set are you viewing?
cases.missing_or_expected_distinction: A missing container can still leave unconditional display/seed result sets from the close-container model; display rows do not prove that a container exists or was closed.
cases.source_to_question_assessment: Container choice and physical hospital-station examples do not define unconditional seed/display SELECTs when the close-container model has no matching record. They cannot answer this SQL row-shape question.

related_source_claims.statement: Grupo Julio describes attempting allocation-rule sequences in order and passing the unallocated remainder to the next sequence when the current one cannot allocate 100 percent. It distinguishes the predefined allocation strategy algorithm from Allocation Location Selection criteria over Location or Location Inventory fields; each rule detail combines the two.
related_source_claims.limits: Grupo Julio reference design v1.5, final 2024-09-03, for its Mexico distribution center. The document version is not an installed product release. No assessed-deployment configuration or execution is established. No complete strategy algorithm or real allocation outcome is established. The existing assignment/default/Always Override record remains separate, and the listed allocation zones/rules are explicitly partial examples.

related_source_claims.statement: Grupo Julio describes a custom inbound quality process before ERP purchase-order creation and SCALE receipt interfacing, expressly excluding base SCALE Inbound QC. Its example samples 10 to 15 percent, while the unloading section allows a larger sample when quality issues are detected.
related_source_claims.limits: Grupo Julio Manhattan Active SCALE design v1.5 (2024-09-03); document revision is not a product release. Historical implementation reference, not TAB configuration. These are attributed site procedures and sampling examples, not SCALE default inspection percentages or a general prerequisite for receiving. The source discusses reprocessing or exceptional destruction; it does not authorize either action in TAB.

related_source_claims.statement: Grupo Julio describes damaged inventory in a specific multi-item location excluded from regular allocation location selections. A separate selection permits shipping damaged product; quality review distinguishes stock to transfer to picking from stock needing adjustment.
related_source_claims.limits: Grupo Julio Manhattan Active SCALE design v1.5 (2024-09-03); document revision is not a product release. Historical implementation reference, not TAB configuration. The design couples status and location selection. A Damaged label alone is not an allocation block: retained AIM inventory-status documentation also requires allocation rules to enforce exclusion. No active status, location, allocation rule or permission to release damaged stock is established.
